title: Family musicians and his father the country doctor
summary: Nobody in his children's generation took up music; his father played organ and was a country doctor, and Bunk Johnson knew him.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, is there any other members of your family like your son or your daughter? No, no, no, no, no.

They're going to take up music? No, no, no. It's me and my brother and my daddy, he's played piano too in organ. He used to play organ at the church in his spare time. Every sudden we'd go to church. He played organ and piano. He's not a fancy piano player but he played it. When he was out in the country he was a pretty good doctor. You had to use it on your own. See, the poor people are 80 miles from here. Just like this doctor come in here and rush to get the ambulance. No hospital out there. No, dirt roads, gravel, horse and bugger, no automobiles. You just had to know what you're doing. Or call in some other doctor to help you.
Didn't you say that Bunk Johnson knew Dr. Nelson?
I'm sure he did. He used to talk about it.
He used to talk about it.
